{
  "database": {
    "tables": [
      {
        "name": "bundles",
        "purpose": "Stores each bundle's identity, mode (fixed or flexible), enabled state, and a system-managed health status.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal id" },
          { "name": "title", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "merchant-facing bundle title" },
          { "name": "description", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NULL", "purpose": "optional merchant description" },
          { "name": "mode", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "enum": ["fixed", "flexible"], "purpose": "distinguishes fixed bundles from flexible bundles" },
          { "name": "enabled", "sqlType": "BOOLEAN", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT false", "purpose": "whether this bundle is active and visible to customers" },
          { "name": "health_status", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'healthy'", "enum": ["healthy", "warned", "auto_disabled"], "purpose": "merchant-facing health signal" },
          { "name": "created_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" },
          { "name": "updated_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "indexes": [["enabled", "created_at"], ["health_status"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_items",
        "purpose": "Stores variant-level products belonging to each bundle, including last-observed availability.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal id" },
          { "name": "bundle_id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the bundle this item belongs to" },
          { "name": "variant_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the specific product variant in Shopify" },
          { "name": "product_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the parent product of the variant" },
          { "name": "observed_availability", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available'", "enum": ["available", "out_of_stock", "deleted"], "purpose": "last known availability state" },
          { "name": "added_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["bundle_id", "variant_external_id"],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "added_at"], ["variant_external_id"], ["bundle_id", "observed_availability"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_tiers",
        "purpose": "Stores each discount tier for a bundle, including minimum item count and discount rate.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal id" },
          { "name": "bundle_id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the bundle this tier belongs to" },
          { "name": "minimum_item_count", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "minimum number of items to qualify for this tier" },
          { "name": "discount_rate", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "discount rate in basis points (e.g. 1000 = 10%)" },
          { "name": "display_order", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "merchant-defined display sequence" },
          { "name": "created_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" },
          { "name": "updated_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["bundle_id", "minimum_item_count"],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "display_order"], ["bundle_id", "minimum_item_count"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_purchase_records",
        "purpose": "Stores a record of every bundle present in a paid order, keyed by order external id to survive webhook retries.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal id" },
          { "name": "bundle_id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the bundle that was purchased" },
          { "name": "order_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the paid Shopify order id" },
          { "name": "order_placed_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "when the order was created" },
          { "name": "variant_external_ids", "sqlType": "JSONB", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'", "purpose": "serialized list of variant ids selected at purchase time" },
          { "name": "item_count", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "number of items in the bundle at purchase" },
          { "name": "discount_rate_applied", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "discount rate in basis points actually applied" },
          { "name": "order_total", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "order total in minor currency units" },
          { "name": "currency_code", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD'", "purpose": "ISO 4217 currency code for order_total" },
          { "name": "recorded_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["order_external_id", "bundle_id"],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "order_placed_at"], ["order_placed_at"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_health_events",
        "purpose": "Logs every automated health change applied to a bundle for merchant audit.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal id" },
          { "name": "bundle_id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the bundle whose health changed" },
          { "name": "event_kind", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "enum": ["auto_disabled", "warned", "cleared"], "purpose": "the type of health change" },
          { "name": "affected_variant_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NULL", "purpose": "the specific variant that triggered this health change" },
          { "name": "reason", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "human-readable reason for the health change" },
          { "name": "occurred_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "occurred_at"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      }
    ]
  },
  "shopifyIntegration": {
    "webhookTopics": [
      "orders/paid",
      "inventory_levels/update",
      "products/delete"
    ],
    "cronSchedule": null
  },
  "httpRoutes": {
    "admin": [
      { "method": "GET", "path": "/admin/bundles", "purpose": "List bundles with pagination and filters" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/create", "purpose": "Create a new bundle" },
      { "method": "PUT", "path": "/admin/bundles/update", "purpose": "Update a bundle" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/remove", "purpose": "Delete a bundle" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/clone", "purpose": "Clone a bundle" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/bulk-status", "purpose": "Bulk enable/disable bundles" },
      { "method": "GET", "path": "/admin/bundles/items", "purpose": "List bundle items" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/items/save", "purpose": "Save bundle items" },
      { "method": "GET", "path": "/admin/bundles/tiers", "purpose": "List bundle tiers" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/tiers/save", "purpose": "Save bundle tiers" },
      { "method": "GET", "path": "/admin/purchase-history", "purpose": "List purchase history" }
    ],
    "widget": [
      { "method": "GET", "path": "/widget/bundle", "purpose": "Fetch bundle config for storefront widget" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/widget/bundle/validate", "purpose": "Validate a bundle selection" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/widget/cart/add", "purpose": "Add bundle to cart with discount" }
    ]
  }
}
